assessment_summary.cou_name: Preliminary decision to freeze mounting-hole pattern and envelope using FEA of rear carrier bracket under worst-case braking load and first-mode target

evidence_keywords: Element-size sweep and solver notes
Mesh A (coarser): 2.5 mm global, 0.8 mm at the fillet; 410k DOF.
Mesh B (finer): 1.6 mm global, 0.5 mm at the fillet; 1.05M DOF.
moved from 176 MPa (A) to 182 MPa (B), a 3.4% increase.
Tip deflection at the pannier point shifted 1.1% between meshes.
Sparse direct solver with pivot check on
default contact stiffness since all interfaces are tied.
Reaction forces at bosses balanced within 0.5% of applied load moments.
model is fit to answer the narrow question
Assumptions that might sway outcomes
Because we did not include clamp-up and adjacent structure
Not approved for final sign-off or durability claims at this time.
Element type: 10-node tets (SOLID187 equivalent).
Contacts: Boss faces treated as bonded to frame; no pretension or friction modeled.
Analysis steps: Linear static; separate undamped eigen-solve for the first six modes.
Geometric nonlinearity left off (max strain << 0.2%).
1.2 kN lateral force applied
95 mm from the boss line of action
Constraints: Contact faces at the two M8 bosses tied to ground
Material: 6061-T6, E=69 GPa, ν=0.33, σy=275 MPa, density 2700 kg/m^3
datasheet values from Kaiser
Quick hand calc using a cantilever idealization
gives 1.04 mm vs FEA 0.98–0.99 mm
≈5–6% difference
acceptable for a sanity check
